answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The ivory lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the knoll is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the ridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
